items.title: Bainbridge Island Mochi Tsuki
items.summary:
Last weekend we took the ferry to Bainbridge Island to see a Mochi Tsuki event.
I read about the history of Japanese immigrants on Bainbridge island.
I saw people making mochi, a taiko drummer group, and traditional dances.
It was a lot of fun, and I learned a lot.  Definitely recommend this event!
